value.rationale: This is a natural comparison of two vertex-transitive cubic eight-vertex graphs with equal vertex/edge/poset-rank parameters. Their incidence-poset rank polynomials differ in only one coefficient by two, yet rowmotion orders differ by the factor 2204, with entirely different extreme orbit statistics. The exact rank defect has a short structural proof and full cycle histograms are reproducible benchmark data; this is a motivated dynamical boundary, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
